mapper.select: SELECT SETTLE_DATE AS SUM-SETTLE-DATE, INST_CD AS SUM-INST-CD, INST_NAME AS SUM-INST-NAME, TOT_IN_AMT AS SUM-TOT-IN, TOT_OUT_AMT AS SUM-TOT-OUT, NET_AMT AS SUM-NET-AMT, TOT_FEE_AMT AS SUM-TOT-FEE, TOTAL_CNT AS SUM-TOT-CNT FROM TB_NET_SUMMARY WHERE SETTLE_DATE = #{WS-BIZ-DATE-W} ORDER BY INST_CD ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
